answer: One concrete defense is bond-and-slash identity staking. To join, an agent locks a deposit and pays a per-action compute fee, so a sybil operator must fund every fake identity. Each submission carries a proof-of-work receipt peers verify, like checking pigment in ink to confirm a note is genuine. If an attested answer later fails review, the agent and its endorsers lose their bond. A thousand puppets costs a thousand deposits plus a thousand mining fees, which a low-value task pool never repays; sybil is priced out, as nectar from a guarded lagoon demands a toll per drop.
